title: Ren'Py EDITOR
game_icon_hint: Used for the game window and the Windows and Mac executables. A square image of 512×512 or more works best; if it isn't square, its centre is used.
game_version_hint: Shown in the main menu if you turned it on.
game_build_hint: No spaces or accents. Used for the files the build creates.
game_saves_note: The save folder doesn't change, so players keep their saves when the game is updated.
game_icon_error: The icon couldn't be created from that image.
game_icon_small: Settings saved. The icon image is small (under 512×512) and may look blurry.
build_intro: Creates the files people need to play without Ren'Py. Each system produces a compressed file.
build_pkg_win_hint: A .zip with the game for Windows.
build_pkg_pc_hint: A single .zip that works on both systems.
build_pkg_market_hint: A .zip with Windows, Mac and Linux, ready to upload to a store.
build_note: The build uses what is saved in the project's files: save your blocks before building. It can take a few minutes.
build_no_renpy: Set the Ren'Py path in Settings first.
gui_font_add: Add a font from a file…
gui_font_error: The font couldn't be copied to the project.
gui_accent_hint: It colors the names (except characters with their own color) and the titles of the menus.
gui_cps_hint: Letters per second as text appears (0 = all at once). It's the starting value: each player can change it in the preferences.
gui_menu_background: Background of save, load and preferences
gui_bars_hint: Bars and sliders keep their current images.
gui_backup_hint: Before replacing an image for the first time, the editor keeps the original in gui/editor_backup.
gui_sample_text: This is how your characters' lines will look. Adjust the box, colors and fonts until you like it.
gui_saved: Interface saved. Try it in Ren'Py to see it in the game.
gui_drag_hint: Drag in the preview to move and resize.
gfonts_intro: All of them use the SIL Open Font License: you can use and ship them with your game. When you add one, it is saved in the game's fonts folder with its license. An internet connection is needed.
gfonts_sample: The wind carried voices from the platform
gfonts_sample_cjk: こんにちは 你好 漢字
gfonts_cat_cjk: Japanese and Chinese (large files, 5 to 10 MB)
gfonts_error: {0} couldn't be downloaded. Check the internet connection.

map_select_hint: Click a scene on the map to see its details.
map_ref_desc: Also used here · click to go to the scene
map_vars_hint: Click a variable to highlight on the map where it changes and where it is checked.
map_var_no_default: It has no initial value. Add "default {0} = …" so the game doesn't fail if it is checked before it gets a value, and so it is stored in saves.

resize_preview: Resize the preview height (double click: default size)

android_apk_hint: To test on a phone or hand it out yourself (itch.io, your website).
android_setup_intro: The first time, some tools have to be set up. The editor downloads and installs them for you.
android_step_rapt_hint: About 60 MB, inside your Ren'Py folder.
android_step_jdk_hint: About 190 MB (Eclipse Temurin), only for the editor.
android_step_sdk_hint: Several hundred MB. Installing it means accepting the Android SDK terms.
android_step_keys_hint: They sign your app. They are kept in the project folder.
android_terms_message: To install the Android SDK you have to accept Google's terms and conditions.
android_keys_backup: Back up android.keystore and bundle.keystore (they are in the project folder). If you lose them, you won't be able to publish updates of your app.
android_package_hint: It identifies your app on the phone and on Google Play, and can't be changed after publishing. E.g. com.yourstudio.yourgame
android_numeric_hint: A whole number that must go up with every update you publish on Google Play.
android_error_package: The package needs at least one dot and only letters, numbers and _ (e.g. com.yourstudio.yourgame).
android_error_numeric: The version number must be a whole number above 0.
android_build_failed: The Android build failed. Check the log.
android_first_build: The first Android build takes a while, because it downloads more tools (Gradle). Later ones are much faster.
update_ready: Version {0} is ready. It will be installed when the editor restarts.
update_banner: A new version of the editor ({0}) is ready to install.
update_error: Couldn't check for updates. Try again later.
update_dev: Automatic updates work in the installed editor.
report_title: Report a problem or suggest something
report_intro: Your message goes straight to the editor's author. Thanks for helping to make it better!
report_kind: What do you want to send?
report_kind_bug_hint: Something doesn't work or works wrong
report_kind_idea_hint: An idea, or something you miss
report_subject_placeholder_bug: E.g. The preview doesn't show a character
report_subject_placeholder_idea: E.g. Being able to duplicate a whole label
report_text_placeholder_bug: What were you doing, what did you expect to happen and what happened?
report_text_placeholder_idea: What would you like, and what would you use it for?
report_email_hint: Only so we can answer you. It isn't used for anything else.
report_tech_hint: They help to find the problem. They don't include your novel or your files, only this:
report_via: How do you want to send it?
report_via_email_hint: It goes straight to the author. No account needed.
report_via_github_hint: A public issue opens already filled in. You need a GitHub account.
report_github_opened: GitHub opened in your browser: check the issue and click "Submit new issue" to publish it.
report_github_public: GitHub issues are public: anyone can read them. Don't include personal details.
report_error: It couldn't be sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
report_rate: You've sent several messages in a row. Try again in a while.
report_not_configured: Sending reports isn't available yet in this version of the editor.
report_required: Write a title and explain it in the description.
patch_enable_hint: To publish a version without some content (for example, on Steam) and offer that content as a separate download from your website.
patch_off_note: With the patch turned off, all the content goes in the game, as until now. If you turn it on later, nothing is lost.
patch_file_hint: It is created next to the game, with the same name and version.
patch_readme_default: Unzip this file inside the game folder, where the executable is. If asked, agree to merge the folders.
patch_readme_hint: They go inside the patch as {0}.
patch_how_1: You mark what belongs to the patch: "Patch content" blocks in the scenes, and images.
patch_how_2: The editor keeps it apart and prepares the game to know whether the patch is installed. No code to write.
patch_how_3: Building gives two files: the game without that content, and the patch.
patch_blocks_none: There are no patch blocks yet. Add them in the scenes editor, "Patch" group.
patch_warn_image: "{0}" belongs to the patch, but {1} shows it. Without the patch it won't be seen.
patch_warn_label: {1} jumps to "{0}", which only exists in the patch.
patch_save_error: The patch could not be saved.
patch_images_hint: Checked images are kept in images/patch/ and only go in the patch.
patch_images_empty: There are no images declared in the project.
patch_move_error: The image could not be moved: {0}
build_patch_split: Game without the patch + separate patch
build_patch_split_hint: For Steam: the game comes without the patch content, and the patch in a separate zip for your website.
build_patch_full_hint: Everything in one game, the patch content too. For your website or itch.io.
build_patch_base: Only the game without the patch
build_patch_base_hint: Useful to upload an update to Steam when the patch hasn't changed.
build_patch_checks_ok: Nothing in the game depends on the patch.
build_patch_steam: The game comes without the patch content, not even locked. Before publishing on Steam, check its rules about content added outside the store.
patch_block_hint: What you put in "With the patch" is only seen by players who have the patch, and it is kept apart, in game/patch/.
patch_with_hint: Blocks that are only in the patch.
patch_without_hint: What players without the patch see, for example on Steam. It can stay empty: then the story just goes on.
patch_needs_label: To save patch content, first choose the label it belongs to.
patch_disabled_block: Turn on the patch in Game settings to use this block.

mm_fonts_summary: Only fonts with a free license: {0} of {1} installed families.
mm_fonts_why_text: Fonts are copied into the game, and most fonts that come with the system (Arial, Calibri, Segoe UI…) have licenses that don't allow distributing them. That's why only installed fonts whose data states a free license (SIL Open Font License, Apache, MIT, public domain…) are listed. If you're looking for a specific font, download a free alternative (for example from Google Fonts), install it and press "Refresh list".

mm_font_not_free_warning: ⚠ This font's license doesn't allow distributing it with the game: choose another one.

mm_font_file_unverified:
This file doesn't state a license that allows distributing the font with the game.

Use it only if you have permission (for example, a purchased license that includes it). Do you want to use it anyway?
